phase1_result.summary: Sampler collapses to zero on real data. All 64 generated embeddings are the zero vector. NN distance ratio = 58.72 (ideal: 1.0).
phase1_result.root_cause: Three compounding failures: (1) sampler feeds noise (norm=15.87) to a model expecting L2-normalized embeddings (norm=1.0), (2) diffusion decoder outputs zero at alpha_bar=0 by design (Q fully diffused), (3) DDPM ancestral update formula does not apply to ESDM (diffusion is internal in Q-space, not external in input-space).
phase1_result.what_model_can_do: Produces meaningful x_hat at alpha_bar > 0 (norm 0.43 at alpha_bar=0.15, 0.95 at 0.85, 0.996 at 0.9999). Decoder is functional but cannot denoise from alpha_bar=0.
phase1_result.required_fix: Redesign sampler to operate in Q-space: reverse the wave recurrence (00-DESIGN.md section 4.2) from tau_max to 0, not apply DDPM in input-space. Design-level change, not parameter tuning.
phase1_result.connection_to_weak_spots: recon_decrease=6.58, net_energy_flow=0, pi_contraction_ratio=3.94 all converge on the same failure: Lambda pump destroys Q-state at alpha_bar=0, making the decoder unable to recover.
